notes.title: Sound toggle key changed
notes.notes: The 'S' key will no longer control toggling sound on/off. This can now be done with the F10 Key and the 'S' can be used to activate the shield.

notes.title: Fix frame rate issue
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue that causes FPS to drop off to below 10 when a USB Controller was not plugged in. Note this issues only occurs on some Hardware configurations.
Additional tuning to Collision Checking for better performance on older hardware
